headline: Farmers market Tuesday, then beat the heat indoors.
lede: Wednesday, August 19. Forecast high near 96°F, low 72°F with a chance of afternoon thunderstorms. Heat index will push 100+. Start early on the water or at a shaded attraction, then move indoors after lunch. Landing Farmers Market is Tuesday-only; check for Wednesday pop-ups or carry forward to next week.

featured.title: Branson Landing Farmers Market
featured.where: South lot by Bass Pro Shops, Branson Landing
featured.why: Local produce, crafts, live music in a walkable setting. Great for first-timers wanting an authentic Ozarks morning/afternoon.
